prompt: Turn this into a clean character turnaround reference sheet for 3D modeling of the character on the left. In both views it stands upright in a neutral relaxed pose, its arms hanging a little away from its body and its hands open and empty. Replace the curtain and the stage with a plain light gray background, soft even studio light and no cast shadow. Keep the character's design, proportions, colors and matte clay look exactly as they are: the big round lime green head with its cream ear pods and short gold collar, the long cream nose under the dark visor, the round lime body with the big cream belly and the lime lightning bolt, the steel coil-spring neck, arms and legs, and the chunky dark boots. Two changes: the visor is plain matte dark charcoal with no eyes and no glow; and the grin and the eyebrow are removed, so the lime face under the visor is smooth. No text, no logos, no props, no other characters.
